note_ja: 工法比較の単価差リスト・範囲差リストから外す工種の区分表。比較前提表の画面で編集でき、使用した区分表は比較前提表JSONに保存される。
note_en: Which cost items are excluded from the unit-price and scope difference lists when construction methods are compared. Editable in the premise-book screen; the classification actually used is saved inside the premise book.

method_specific.note_ja: 片方の工法にしか存在しない工種。単価差・範囲差の両方から外す。
method_specific.note_en: Items that exist in one construction method only. Excluded from both lists.

method_dependent_work.note_ja: 同じ工種キーでも工法によって仕事の中身が違う工種。単価差リストから外し、範囲差リストには残す。
method_dependent_work.note_en: Items whose work differs by construction method under the same key. Excluded from the unit-price list, kept in the scope list.

families.note_ja: 工法固有の工種でも、どれか1つは必ず必要な部位。1つも無いProjectは範囲差として挙げる。
families.note_en: Parts every building needs in some form, even though the member items are method-specific. A Project with none of them is listed as a scope gap.
